menu.when: starting a new game — always before writing any game-specific code
game logic that must be unit-tested and fuzz-tested
any client-server remote — generates Guard + RateLimit handler
server-side validation of every client-sent value
preventing client flood attacks on any RemoteEvent
proving no crashes under hostile inputs (NaN, inf, wrong types)
proving specs catch real bugs in shared modules
catching unguarded remotes and backdoor patterns before ship
any timed game logic — never os.clock() in shared state
proving replication, remote validation and in-engine behaviour

ladder.when: logic must be fuzz-tested or mutation-tested
simulation clock, combat timing or audio sync

floor: every remote handler uses Guard.* + RateLimit — parallax audit must pass
shared modules are pure (no GetService/Instance.new) — shared_pure_gate
fuzz 0 crashes + mutate >=80% before Studio playtest
Studio 2-client playtest with 0 console errors before sign-off
